testPolicy.text: Northeastern University is test-optional, and standardized test scores are not required to complete an application for admission.

cost.totalIncludes: first-year students on the Boston, New York City or Oakland campuses: tuition 71,050 + fees 1,650 + housing 13,612 + food 9,210 + books and course materials 1,000 + personal 900 + transportation 900 = 98,322 (estimated annual direct and indirect costs, subject to Board of Trustee approval). Different totals apply to first-years who start in the N.U.in program abroad or the London Scholars Program.

aidPromise.text: Northeastern remains committed to meeting the full demonstrated financial need for every undergraduate student who attends the university; it invested a record $511 million in financial aid (not loans) for 2025-26.

deadlines.early: November 1 (Early Decision I, decision by January 1; Early Action, decision by February 15); January 1 (Early Decision II, decision by March 1)

facts.text: Northeastern is one of the most applied-to private universities: 105,283 first-year applicants for fall 2025 and 106,300 for fall 2026, while fall 2024 saw 5,133 admits from 98,425 applicants.
The co-op program places students in six-month professional jobs, so graduates leave with up to 18 months of work experience; 58 percent are offered a job by a previous co-op employer.

Some admits start their first year abroad: the N.U.in fall semester costs $46,600 in direct costs (tuition plus a program fee covering housing and flights) and is not eligible for federal aid; the London Scholars year costs $93,200 in direct costs.

Northeastern offers four rounds: binding Early Decision I (November 1) and II (January 1), non-binding Early Action (November 1) and Regular Decision (January 1); in fall 2024, 1,492 of 3,466 ED applicants were admitted.

Testing is optional and only 24 percent of the fall 2024 enrolled class submitted SAT scores; the university reports an average two-part SAT of 1480 and an average high school GPA of 4.2 for the Class of 2029.

notes: The Common Data Set page (https://uds.northeastern.edu/university-facts/common-data-set/) lists CDS up to 2024-25 only (CDS-2025-26.pdf returns 404). No official fall 2025 count of admits and enrolled was found: Northeastern Global News gives only 105,283 applicants for fall 2025 (average SAT 1480, average GPA 4.2) and 106,300 applicants for fall 2026, so the cycle falls back to CDS 2024-25 (fall 2024). C1 fall 2024: applied 42,678 men + 55,719 women + 28 unknown = 98,425; admitted 2,058 + 3,074 + 1 = 5,133; enrolled 1,089 + 1,667 + 3 = 2,759; residency: in-state 12,304 applied / 1,332 admitted / 737 enrolled. CDS C12 GPA left blank. Fall 2024 scores, not fall 2025. Aid promise taken from the university news office (2025-10-31); the admissions cost page did not state it. Test-optional start date not stated.
